query: DELETE FROM billing_ch_events WHERE event_key IN (SELECT e.event_key FROM billing_ch_events e JOIN billing_ch_batches b ON e.batch_id=b.id WHERE b.status=1 AND b.completed_at<$1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM billing_outbox o WHERE o.ch_batch_id=b.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM billing_dlq d WHERE d.ch_batch_id=b.id) ORDER BY e.event_key LIMIT 1000 FOR UPDATE OF e SKIP LOCKED)
